title: Tulip with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="petalGrad" cx="50%" cy="40%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff6090"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#cc2060"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="petalGrad2" cx="50%" cy="40%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff80a8"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e03070"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="stemGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#40c060"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#208040"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="leafGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#50d070"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#28a048"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Stem -->
  <rect x="46" y="52" width="8" height="40" rx="3" fill="url(#stemGrad)"/>

  <!-- Left leaf -->
  <path d="M46 78 Q26 68 18 80 Q28 82 46 88 Z" fill="url(#leafGrad)" stroke="#60e088" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Right leaf -->
  <path d="M54 72 Q74 62 82 74 Q70 78 54 84 Z" fill="url(#leafGrad)" stroke="#60e088" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Back petals -->
  <path d="M30 20 Q25 40 50 52 Q75 40 70 20 Q60 10 50 16 Q40 10 30 20 Z" fill="url(#petalGrad)"/>

  <!-- Left front petal -->
  <path d="M28 22 Q18 40 34 52 Q44 50 46 40 Q44 26 28 22 Z" fill="url(#petalGrad2)" stroke="#ff90b0" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Right front petal -->
  <path d="M72 22 Q82 40 66 52 Q56 50 54 40 Q56 26 72 22 Z" fill="url(#petalGrad2)" stroke="#ff90b0" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Center petal (lighter, smiling face here) -->
  <path d="M50 12 Q38 18 38 36 Q38 50 50 54 Q62 50 62 36 Q62 18 50 12 Z" fill="#ffb0c8" stroke="#ffd0e0" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Smiling face on center petal -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="32" rx="3.5" ry="4" fill="#402060"/>
  <ellipse cx="56" cy="32" rx="3.5" ry="4" fill="#402060"/>
  <!-- Eye highlights -->
  <circle cx="45.2" cy="30.8" r="1.3" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="57.2" cy="30.8" r="1.3" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M43 40 Q50 47 57 40" fill="none" stroke="#402060" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx="39" cy="38" r="3" fill="#ff7090" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="38" r="3" fill="#ff7090" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Small crown/tip highlight -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="15" r="2" fill="#ffe0f0" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
